# Monthly budget review

Subscriptions creep up quietly, so list them all twice a year and cancel the unused ones. The avalanche method pays the highest interest debt first and saves the most money. Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month. Rebalance the portfolio once a year rather than reacting to every market headline. A monthly review compares planned and actual spending by category and adjusts next month.

## Why it matters

Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month. Rebalance the portfolio once a year rather than reacting to every market headline. Automate savings on payday so the money moves before it can be spent. Keep receipts for deductible expenses in one folder so the yearly tax filing takes an evening. An emergency fund of three to six months of essential costs covers most surprises. A sinking fund spreads a known future cost, such as a new laptop, across the months before it.

Rebalance the portfolio once a year rather than reacting to every market headline. The avalanche method pays the highest interest debt first and saves the most money. Automate savings on payday so the money moves before it can be spent.
